g.text: Partial verification through JAS 2026 (center: August). PMM is reconstructed, not the official extension.
Parameter-out-of-sample retrospective analysis; training ends in 2024. Nine-month paths are displayed;
only available common lead-1–5 seasonal pairs are scored. These pairs are not independent samples.
